name: Hope Defered
overview: Scripture reveals that hope delayed can cause deep sorrow and discouragement, as Proverbs 13:12 illustrates by describing a deferred hope as making the heart sick. Yet, the fulfillment of that hope brings life and joy, likened to a tree of life. In the midst of waiting, Christ’s call to faith encourages believers not to fear but to trust in Him, as seen in Mark 5:36. Furthermore, Romans 15:13 assures that God, the source of hope, fills believers with joy and peace through faith, enabling them to abound in hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
